verses.text: \s1 Paupuina

\x - \xo 1:1 \xt Sawl 17:1\x*Paul, Silas le Timothy te in, Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ sung a om Thessalonica pawlpi te tung ah: i Pa Pathian le Topa Jesus Christ tung pan in thuthiamna le thinnopna note tungah hong om tahen.   
\s1 Thessalonica Pawlpi te Upna
Note theampo atu in Pathian tungah tatsat ngawl in lungdam ka ko uh hi, ka thungetna uh sungah hong pawk tawntung khu hi;
I Pa Pathian mai ah na upna uh taw na sepna uh, itna taw in na sep uh te le i Topa Jesus Christ sungah na lametna uh taw na thuakzawkna uh te kong phawk tawntung uh hi;
Kong it suapui te awng, Pathian tealsa te na hi uh hi, ci ka he uh hi.

Banghangziam cile i lungdamna thupha sia note tungah kam bek in hong theng ngawl hi, ahihang Thaa Thiangtho sungah vangletna le thinmuanna tampi taw hong theng hi; note atu in note sungah kote bangbang mihing khu ziam, ci na he uh hi.
\x - \xo 1:6 \xt Sawl 17:5-9\x*Taciang note in Pathian thu sia haksatna tampi le Tha Thiangtho kung pan hongpai lungdamna taw sang zo na hi uhkom in, kote le Topa nungzui te na suak zo uh hi:
Tua ahikom Macedonia le Achaia a om thu um theampo tungah ettetak te na hi tavun.

Bangbangziam cile note tung pan Topa thu hong thawn sia Macedonia le Achaia bek hi ngawl in, Pathian na upna uh sia mun tatuam ah ki zel kakoai hi; tua ahikom thudang bangma ka son tuan tu om ngawl hi.
Banghangziam cile note kungah bangbang in hong tum khu ziam, ci thu ahizong, a nungta le a thuman Pathian na seam tu in milim te kung pan in Pathian kungah bangbang in kihei nu ziam, ci thu ahizong;
Taciang hongpai pheang tu Pathian thin-ukna pan in hong suaktasak le thina pan a thawkiksak a Tapa Jesus vantung pan hongpai tu na ngak na thu uh ahizong, amate in hong tangko zo uh hi.
\s1 Thessalonica ah Paul Nasepna
Banghangziam cile suapui te awng, note kungah kong tumna uh sia a luithathong hi ngawl hi, ci note mama in na he uh hi:

\x - \xo 2:2 \xt 2:2: a \xt Sawl 16:19-24; \xt Sawl17:1-9.\x*Ahihang note i na heak uh bangma in, Philippi ah maizumhuai tak in hong koi uh a, ka thuak zawk uh ciang zong, note kungah Pathian lungdamna thupha sia ki nialna tampi taw hil tu in Pathian sungah hangsanna ka nei uh hi.
Banghangziam cile kote i hanthotna sia khialna, thiantho ngawl na, le theamna hi ngawl hi:
Ahihang lungdamna thupha keamcing tu in Pathian in hong sawl bang in; mihing lungkimsak tu bang hi ngawl in, kote i thinsung a en Pathian lungkimsak te bang in ka pau uh hi.
Banghangziam cile na heaksa uh bangma in, banghun po ahizong sialpokna kammal te ka zang ngei bua uh hi, duhopna phualseal kammal te zong ka zang bua uh hi; Pathian sia ka tetti uh a hihi:
Christ i sawltak te ka hi uh bangma in, vanngit hong suan thei hi ka le ung, note tung pan ahizong, ngualdang tung pan ahizong, mihing tung pan in minthanna ka zong bua uh hi.
Ahihang nau keam nu in nauno te a khoi bang in, kote zong note sungah thin neamtak in kong om uh hi:
Note kong it mama uh hu in, note tungah Pathian lungdamna thupha bek hi ngawl in, ka nuntakna zong kong pia nuam uh hi, banghangziam cile note sia kong it mamate na hi uh hi.

Banghangziam cile, suapui te awng, ka nasep uh le ka thuak uh haksatna te, na phawk tawntung uh hi: banghangziam cile note kungah vanngit ka hi thei ngawl natu in sun le zan in na ka seam uh a, Pathian lungdamna thupha note kong hil uh hi.
No thu um mite sungah thiangtho tak, thutang tak le pauban na om ngawl in ka nungta uh hi, ci note le Pathian sia ka tetti te na hi uh hi:
Pa in a tate tungah a vawt bang in, kote in note sia bangbang in hong hantawn in, hong heneam khu ziam, taciang note tungah kong vaitha uh hi, ci na he uh hi,
Tabang in note sia Ama kumpingam le minthanna sungah hongsam Pathian taw a kilawm in na nuntak tu uh a hihi.

Hi thu hang in tatsat ngawl in Pathian tung lungdam ka ko uh hi, banghangziam cile kote tung pan in na zak uh Pathian thu na san uh lai in, mihing kammal bang in na sang bua uh hi, ahihang thuman bang in na sang uh hi, tua Pathian thu in a um note sungah phattuamna tampi taw na seam hi.

\x - \xo 2:14 \xt Sawl 17:5 \x*Banghangziam cile, suapui te awng, note Christ Jesus sungah Judah ngam a om Pathian pawlpi a zui te na suak uh hi: banghangziam cile amate in Judah mite tungah a thuak uh bang in, note zong na ngam mite tung pan na thuak uh hi:

\x - \xo 2:15 \xt Sawl 9:23,29; 13:45,50; 14:2,5,19; 17:5,13; 18:12.\x*Judah te in Topa Jesus le amate kamsang te that uh hi, taciang kote hong vawtsia uh a; Pathian lungkimsak ngawl uh hi, taciang mi theampo taw ki langpan uh hi:

Gentile te ngupna a nga thei natu in ka thuhil natu hong khak hi, taciang mawna taw kidim tawntung uh hi: banghangziam cile Pathian thin-ukna sia a khakbel in amate tungah hong theng hi.   
\s1 Paul in Thessalonica Haw Kik Nuam
Ahihang suapui te awng, thinsung bek hi ngawl in, cilesa lam taw tawmvei sung i ki khen a, note maitang mu nop na lianpi taw nasiatak in ka hanciam uh hi.
Tua ahikom note kungah kong pai nuam uh a, keima Paul vateak zong, khatvei kongpai kik nuam hi; ahihang Satan in hong khak hi.
Banghangziam cile kote i lametna, lungdamna le lungdamna kham lukhu sia bang ziam? I Topa Jesus Christ hongpai ciang in Ama mai ah note hi ngawl nu ziam?
\x - \xo 3:1 \xt Sawl 17:5\x*Tua ahikom ka thuakzawk nawn ngawl uh ciang in, keima bek Athens ah tang leng pha tu hi, ci in ka ngaisun uh hi;
Taciang i suapui pa, Pathian naseam le Christ i lungdamna thupha sungah ka naseppui uh Timothy sia note kipsak tu le note i upna taw kisai in note heneam tu in kong paisak uh hi:
Tabang in hi haksatna hu in kuama hong lok bua tu hi: banghangziam cile kote sia hi haksatna te thuak tu in a ciangtan sate ka hi uh hi, ci sia note mama in na he uh hi.
Banghangziam cile note kungah ka om uh lai in, haksatna ka thuak tu uh hi, ci sia mantak in hong son zo khu hi; kong son uh bangma in hong theng takpi hi, ci na he uh hi.

Hi thu hang in, ka thuak zawk ngawl uh ciang in, na up thei natu uh in Timothy kong paisak uh hi, tabang hi bale, ze-et pa in hong ze-et tu a, ka nasepna uh te a luithathong suak tu hi.   
\s1 Timothy Tung Pan Lungdamna Thu

\x - \xo 3:6 \xt Sawl 18:5\x*Ahihang tu in Timothy sia note kung pan kote kungah hong theng zo hi, taciang na upna uh le itna lungdamna thupha hong puak hi, taciang note in phatak in tatsat ngawl nong phawk uh a, kote in note kong mu nop uh bangma in, nong mu nuam takpi uh hi:
Tua ahikom, suapui te awng, na upna uh tungtawn in ka haksatna uh le ka thinngimna uh theampo sungah nong heneam uh hi:
Banghangziam cile, note Topa sungah kiptak in na ding uh ahile, tu in kote ka nungta uh hi.
I Pathian mai ah note hang in, ka lungdamna uh theampo atu in, Pathian tungah bang pokna te ka pia kik tu uh ziam?
Note upna a ki samlai te a kicin thei natu ahizong, na maitang ka mu thei natu uh ahizong, sun le zan in nasiatak in thu ka ngen tawntung uh hi.
Tu in i Pa Pathian ama vateak le i Topa Jesus Christ in note omna kong paina ka lampi uh ah hong makai tahen.
Taciang kote in note kong it uh bang in, note khat le khat ahizong, mi theampo tung ahizong, Topa in itna sungah khang in hong pungsak tahen:
I Topa Jesus Christ sia a mithiangtho theampo taw hongpai ciang in, na thinsung uh te i Pa Pathian mai ah pauban na om ngawl, thianthona taw a tawpdong in hong kipsak tahen.
\s1 Pathian Lungkimsak Nuntakna

Tua bek domngawl in, suapui te awng, Pathian sia bangbang in lungkimsak tu, ci le na nuntakzia tu uh te ko te tung pan sang zo na hi uh bangma in, na khanto seseam thei natu uh in, Topa Jesus tungtawn in hantawn in kong thum uh hi.
Banghangziam cile Topa Jesus tungtawn in kong piak uh thupiak te na he uh hi.
Banghangziam cile na thiantho natu uh in, paktat mawna te na pial tu uh sia Pathian i deina a hihi:
Tabang in note sungah khatsim in ama i beal thianthona le zatakna taw bangbang in nei tu ci na heak tu uh kisam hi;
Pathian a he ngawl Gentile te bang in, a ki tek zo ngawl lungngulna nei heak vun:

Kote in kidop natu thu kong pia zo uh a, tetti ka pan uh sa bangma in, mi khat po in bang thu po ahizong seam khial heak tahen a, theamna taw a neisa laksak heak tahen: banghangziam cile Topa sia tabang te theampo phula pa a hihi.
Banghangziam cile Pathian in eite sia a thiangtho ngawl tu in hong sam ngawl hi, ahihang thiangtho tu in hong sam hi.
Tua ahikom ngual a thusimngawl te sia mihing thusimngawl hi ngawl a, Ama Thaa Thiangtho hong pia Pathian a thusim nagwl a hihi.
Ahihang u le nau ki itna taw kisai in note tungah lai kong at tu na kisam bua uh hi: banghangziam cile note khat le khat ki it tu in Pathian in hong hil zo hi.
Taciang Macedonia ngamsung theampo a om suapui te theampo tungah na vawt takpi uh hi: ahihang, suapui te awng, na itna uh khangsak seseam tu in kong thum uh hi;
Taciang thu kong piaksa uh bangma in, om khipkhep vun a, noma khut vateak taw noma na tek seam vun;

Tabang in a puasang mite tungah a man in na nungta tu uh a, bangma kisapna na nei batu uh hi.   
\s1 Thawkikna le Lametna
Ahihang suapui te awng, ngualdang lametna nei ngawl te bang in, na khuangai ngawl natu uh in, a mu te thu taw kisai, he ngawl in na om tu uh ka dei bua hi.
Banghangziam cile Jesus sia thi a, thokik hi, ci i um ahile, Jesus sungah a mu te zong Pathian in Ama taw hong pui kik tu hi.
\x - \xo 4:15 \xt 1 Cor 15:51, 52\x*Banghangziam cile note tungah kong son uh hi thu te sia Topa kammal a hihi, Topa hong thet dong a nungta in a tanglai eite in a mu te i suangkhial bua tu hi.
Banghangziam cile Topa ama tatak vanpan in aw ngingtak taw ahizong, vantungmi i aw taw ahizong, Pathian i lemle taw ahizong, hong tuaksuk tu hi: taciang Christ sungah a thi te tho masa tu hi:
Tuazawkciang in a nungta lai eite sia van lai ah Topa muak tu in, amate taw mei sungah hong la khawm tu hi: taciang Topa taw a tawntung in i omkhawm tu hi.
Tua ahikom hi kammal te taw khat le khat na ki heneam tavun.
Ahi tazong suapui te awng, hun le khuahun thu te note tungah lai taw kong at tu ki sam ngawl hi.
Banghangziam cile zan in nguta hongpai bang in, Topa ni zong tabang hi tu hi, ci sia noma mama in a kicingtak in na he uh hi.
Banghangziam cile naupai nupi nautun nat bang in; amate in nuam in thim khipkhep hi, a ci uh laitak in amate tungah upmawk ngawl pi in hong theng tu hi; taciang amate suakta ngawl tu hi.
Ahihang, suapui te awng, tua ni ciang nguta bang hong phak pak tu in, note khuazing sungah na om bua uh hi.
Note theampo sia khuavak tate na hi uh hi, taciang sun i tate na hi uh hi: eite sia zan i tate i hi bua hi, khuazing tate zong i hi bua hi.
Tua ahikom ngualdang te mut bang in, mu ba tawng; eite kinging le pilvang in ngak tawng.
Banghangziam cile a mu te sia zan lai in mu uh hi; taciang zukham te zong zan ciang in kham uh hi.
\x - \xo 5:8 \xt Isa 59:17; Eph 6:13-17\x*Ahihang sun i ta eite, pilvang in om tawng, upna le itna awmdal bel tawng; taciang lukhu atu in ngupna i lametna khu tawng.
Banghangziam cile Pathian in thin-ukna atu in a ciangtan te i hi bua hi, ahihang i Topa Jesus Christ tungtawn in ngupna nga tu in hong ciangtan sa te i hihi.
Eite i khanglo zong, i mu zong, eite atu in a thi Ama taw i nungta khawm tu hi.

Tua ahikom, tu in na ngamtat uh bangma in, noma le noma ki heneam tavun, taciang khat le khat ki khangsak tavun.   
\s1 A Khakbel Vaithakna
Suapui te awng, note sungah naseam te, Topa sungah na lampui uh te le note hong tek te zakta tu in kong thum uh hi;
Taciang amate nasep nate hang in itna sungah a sang mama in ngaisun tavun. Taciang note sungah thinnopna hong om tahen.
Tu in, suapui te awng, thu ni ngawl datham te kidop natu thupia vun, a thaneam te hu vun, mi theampo tungah thinsau vun, ci in kong hanthawn uh hi.
Khat po i tungah na phangawl te na phangawl tawma in thukkik ngawl tu in kidawm vun; ahihang note sungah ahizong, mi theampo tungah ahizong, thu pha te zui tawntung vun.
Tatsat ngawl in thungen vun.
Na theampo ah lungdam ko vun: banghangziam cile hi sia in note taw kisai in Christ Jesus sungah Pathian deina a hihi.
Thaa mei-kuang mitsak heak vun.
Kamsang thu pualak nate thusimngawl heak vun.
Na theampo sittel vun; na pha te khotak in lenkip vun.
A phangawl in a kilang na theampo pial vun.

Taciang thinnopna Pathian in hong thiansua thiangtho ta hen; taciang note i thaa, na nuntakna uh le na pumpi uh sia, i Topa Jesus Christ hong thet dong, paubang ngawl in na kepcing natu uh Pathian tungah thungen tawng.
Note hongsam pa sia thuman a, Ama in hong seam tu hi.
Suapui te awng, thu hong ngetsak tavun.
Suapui te theampo a thiangtho kinap na taw na nukset vun.
Hi laithak sia a thiangtho suapui theampo tungah sim tu in Topa min taw kong vaitha hi.
I Topa Jesus Christ thuthiamna note tungah hong om tahen. Amen.
